correctness.rationale: For fixed positive gamma,Gamma,Omega,temperature and finite μ, strict reservoir jump support yields unique fixed-Delta stationary state. As Delta→∞ low energy-state reservoir balances give p_g=a p0,p_e=b p0, while local dephasing exchange at order Delta^-2 gives p_d=(p_g+p_e)/2; coherences are O(Delta^-2), reservoir detuned leakage smaller. Thus populations ∝(1,a,b,(a+b)/2). Passive-state sorting assigns the largest energy to min(1,b)/Z, yielding a kink at b=1, μ=ε+Ω. Fraction tanh h below, 1−exp(−(μ−ε)/θ)/cosh h above, with sequential μ→∞ limit. Independently assembled full 4x4 Lindblad Liouvillian and solved stationary density at ten settings; energy/ergotropy coefficients matched within bounded-detuning precision.
